items.title: US marks 250th birthday with fireworks, flyovers and extreme weather
items.description: US President Donald Trump's speech included some of his political agenda but also honoured war veterans and American history.

items.title: Ukraine hits major oil terminal in Russia's St Petersburg
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky says the target is key infrastructure "that generates revenue for Russia's war".

items.title: Evacuations in Guam as super typhoon Bavi approaches
items.description: The storm is forecast to bring winds in excess of 160mph and waves nearly 11m high when it makes landfall on Monday.

items.title: Chinese underground church figure Jin Mingri freed from prison
items.description: The Zion Church founder's release comes after a direct plea to Xi Jinping from Donald Trump.

items.title: Former chess champion Kramnik banned over cheating remarks
items.description: The former Russian world chess champion had accused other players, including the late Daniel Naroditsky, of cheating.

items.title: Moment of destiny for France's Le Pen in verdict to decide her future in presidential race
items.description: Far-right leader Marine Le Pen is appealing against a verdict which found her guilty of misusing EU funds.

items.title: Pope urges Europe to do more for migrants as he visits gateway island
items.description: The pontiff pays tribute to migrants who lost their lives at sea at a cemetery on the Italian island of Lampedusa.

items.title: Row after Indian state drops eggs from school lunch menu
items.description: West Bengal's move to replace eggs in some school meals has sparked a wider debate over nutrition and choice.

items.title: Taylor Swift marries Travis Kelce in NYC ceremony officiated by Adam Sandler
items.description: The star-studded celebration saw several streets in Midtown Manhattan shut, as hordes of fans gathered outside the arena.

items.title: Large crowds gather in Tehran on first day of Ayatollah Khamenei's funeral
items.description: Ali Khamenei's body will lie in state in Tehran's Grand Mosalla until Monday, before travelling across Iran and Iraq.

items.title: Keiko Fujimori declared winner of Peru's presidential election weeks after vote
items.description: The daughter of disgraced president Alberto Fujimori is declared winner of tight race nearly a month after voting took place.

items.title: Anguished families left to identify Venezuela quake victims at makeshift morgue
items.description: The disaster has overwhelmed local services, with bodies put outside or in tents for identification.
